pr.title: feat(etag): allow for custom hashing methods to be used to etag

summary: This PR adds a `generateDigest` option to the etag middleware allowing custom hashing algorithms (e.g., SHA-256) instead of the hardcoded SHA-1, with tests validating the new behavior for the primary feature. The main risk is an unrelated, unexplained removal of `await c.res.blob()` in the 304 Not Modified path, which could reintroduce a previously-fixed stream-handling issue since no test covers this specific line's removal.

findings.rationale: The line `await c.res.blob() // Force using body` was removed. This line was likely present to force consumption of the underlying stream (e.g., to avoid issues with unconsumed body streams / to properly release resources or ensure downstream middleware/adapters behave correctly) before replacing c.res with the 304 response. Removing it could reintroduce a bug it was fixing, or leave a stream unconsumed/hanging on some runtimes (e.g., Node, Deno, Bun) causing warnings or resource leaks. This change is unrelated to the stated feature (custom hashing) and not explained/tested.
findings.suggestedCheck: Verify why 'await c.res.blob()' was originally added (check git blame/history) and confirm removing it does not reintroduce a previously fixed issue with hanging streams or 304 responses in Node/Deno/Bun adapters. Add a regression test for the 304 path across runtimes.

findings.rationale: generateDigest's signature is now exported/used with an additional required 'generator' parameter, changing its API contract. Since this is an internal module (not re-exported publicly per etag/index.ts), impact is likely limited to internal callers, but any other internal usage of digest.ts's generateDigest elsewhere would break if it exists.
findings.suggestedCheck: Search the codebase for any other imports of './digest' generateDigest to confirm all callers were updated.

findings.rationale: No test covers the removal of 'await c.res.blob()' behavior for the 304 path (e.g., verifying body stream is properly consumed/closed) after the refactor, so a subtle regression here could go unnoticed by CI.
findings.suggestedCheck: Add/confirm a test exercising the 304 Not Modified path end-to-end (including checking that the original response stream is not left open) across supported runtimes.
